sentences.text: The next words are for you.
Perhaps what troubles you most is that this is not the first time.
You have confessed this same weakness before, and here it is again.
That can make forgiveness feel almost dishonest, as if you were taking advantage of God.
Yet Scripture never puts a limit on returning.
Each honest return is part of how change happens.
God is not tired of hearing from you.
He is patiently forming something new in you.
There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

sentences.text: Nothing needs to be solved.
Let your breathing find its own unhurried rhythm, and let your hands lie open, as if they had just released something heavy.
Father, I end this day in your mercy.
Thank you for hearing my confession and answering it with forgiveness.
Thank you for the person I will speak to tomorrow, and for the courage you will give me then.
Watch over me through the night.
Let me rest as one who is clean, welcomed, and deeply loved.
I place my sleep and my waking in your hands.
Amen.

sentences.text: Confession is not meant to crush you.
It is the moment you can stop guarding the secret, because the One who hears it has already chosen mercy.
Lord, here is the part I have been reluctant to admit, even to myself.
I did it because I wanted to protect my image, to win the argument, or to avoid feeling small.
I do not want to dress it up as something nobler.
I confess it as sin, and I ask you to forgive me.
Thank you that your patience with me is deeper than my embarrassment tonight.

When those thoughts come back in the dark, remind me that you know me more completely than my worst memory does.
Quiet the voice that keeps the record open.
I place the whole list in your hands, the recent pages and the old ones too.

sentences.text: I give you permission to keep shaping me.
Create in me a clean heart, O God;
and renew a right spirit within me.
I am honest with God about what I did today.
I am forgiven because God delights in mercy, not because I have earned it.
I am free to make repair without being ruled by shame.
I release the person who hurt me into God's hands.
I can learn from this day without being defined by it.
Tomorrow I begin again, as someone welcomed and held by the Father.

sentences.text: What remains is to receive.
And he arose, and came to his father.
But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
Father, thank you for running toward me when I turn back.
Thank you for the embrace that comes before my explanation is complete.
As I lie down, let me rest like someone who has come home, not like someone still standing at the gate.
Let the quiet of this room feel like the quiet of your house, where I am known and wanted.
I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

sentences.text: We are close to rest now.
Hear how God feels about showing mercy.
Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage?
he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
Lord, thank you that you enjoy showing mercy.
Thank you for every time you have forgiven me without reminding me of my failures.
Thank you for the people who have shown me grace when I did not deserve it, because their kindness was a reflection of yours.
Let gratitude grow in me tonight until it is larger than my regret.
I want to fall asleep thankful, not ashamed.

sentences.text: God is greater than your heart.
You do not need to add anything to it or argue with it.
Simply breathe at your own pace, and notice that you are still here, still loved, still being spoken to with kindness.
In a moment, we pray for the person you may need to make things right with.
Father, bring to mind the person who may need to hear from me.
If I owe an apology, help me say it without explaining it away.
If I need to correct something I said, give me the humility to do it plainly.
If the situation is complicated, give me wisdom about timing and words.
I do not want to repair things in order to look good.
I want to love this person well.

sentences.text: Their response belongs to them.
My part is truthfulness and kindness.
Father, I think of the people under my own roof, or the people I speak with most often.
Familiarity makes it easy to be careless with them.
Forgive me for the impatience I would never show a stranger.
Forgive me for the assumptions I make about what they meant.
Help me notice their tiredness and their efforts.
Let my home be a place where forgiveness is spoken out loud and received without keeping score.
And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

Where impatience has become a habit, grow patience in me.
Where I have learned to shade the truth, make me honest.
Where I keep reaching for control, teach me trust.

Create in me a clean heart, O God;
and renew a right spirit within me.

sentences.text: I ignored a call I should have answered.
You are not writing a confession for anyone else.
You are simply letting the truth have a shape, so that mercy has something specific to meet.
Lord, I name the words I spoke today that were harsher than they needed to be.
I remember the tone as well as the sentence, and I remember the face of the person who heard it.
I cannot take those words back into my mouth.
I ask you to forgive me for them, and to soften whatever they hurt.
Show me tomorrow whether an apology is needed, and help me offer it simply.

Their response belongs to them.
My part is truthfulness and kindness.
